messages.content: You are a coding agent in a terminal. Follow the requested output size exactly. Use apply_patch to provide code. Do not inspect files first.
The test tests/test_parser.py::test_empty_input fails with IndexError. Find the cause in src/parser.py and fix it.

Write one apply_patch call that adds tests/test_parser_generated.py. Include 1000 separate named tests, test_integer_0001 through test_integer_1000. Each function must assert parse(str(N))[0] == N with its own literal integer N. Write every function explicitly; do not use loops, parametrization, ellipses, or abbreviations. The patch must contain all 1000 functions before it ends.
